description_en: Queries the hosts in a bastion host
description_zh: 查询指定堡垒机实例下的主机列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-hosts --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHosts

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to query hosts.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
要查询主机的堡垒机实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host on which you want to query hosts.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要查询主机的堡垒机所在地域的ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10.

We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
设置分页查询时，每页显示的主机信息的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条主机信息。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The operating system of the host that you want to query. Valid values:

Linux

Windows
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的主机的操作系统。取值：
Linux
Windows
parameters.name: os_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the host that you want to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的主机名称。不支持模糊查询，只支持精确查询
parameters.name: host_name

parameters.help_en: The address of the host that you want to query. You can set this parameter to a domain name or an IP address. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的主机地址，可使用域名或IP地址。不支持模糊查询，只支持精确查询
parameters.name: host_address

parameters.help_en:
The source of the host that you want to query. Valid values:

Local: a host in a data center

Ecs: an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance

Rds: a host in an ApsaraDB MyBase dedicated cluster
parameters.help_zh:
要查询主机的来源。取值：
Local：本地主机
Ecs：ECS实例
Rds：RDS专属集群主机
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECS instance or the host in an ApsaraDB MyBase dedicated cluster that you want to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的主机对应的ECS实例ID或专属集群主机ID。不支持模糊查询，只支持精确查询
parameters.name: source_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the host that you want to query. Valid values:

Normal: normal

Release: released
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的主机状态。取值：
Normal：正常
Release：已释放
parameters.name: source_instance_state

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host group to which the host to be queried belongs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html operation to query the ID of the host group
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的主机所在主机组的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html接口获取主机组ID
parameters.name: host_group_id

Hosts.description_en: An array that consists of the hosts returned

ActiveAddressType.description_en:
The address type of the host. Valid values:

Public: a public address

Private: a private address
ActiveAddressType.description_zh:
主机地址类型。取值：
Public ：公网地址
Private ：私网地址

HostPrivateAddress.description_en: The private address of the host. The value is a domain name or an IP address
HostPrivateAddress.description_zh: 主机的私网地址，可为域名或IP地址

HostPublicAddress.description_en: The public address of the host. The value is a domain name or an IP address
HostPublicAddress.description_zh: 主机的公网地址，可为域名或IP地址

OSType.description_en:
The operating system of the host. Valid values:

Linux

Windows
OSType.description_zh:
主机的操作系统。取值：
Linux
Windows

Source.description_en:
The source of the host. Valid values:

Local: a host in a data center

Ecs: an ECS instance

Rds: a host in an ApsaraDB MyBase dedicated cluster
Source.description_zh:
主机的来源。取值：
Local：本地主机
Ecs：ECS实例
Rds：RDS专属集群主机

SourceInstanceId.description_en:
The ID of the ECS instance or the host in an ApsaraDB MyBase dedicated cluster.

No value is returned for this parameter if the Source parameter is set to Local
SourceInstanceId.description_zh:
主机对应的ECS实例ID或专属集群主机ID。
Source为Local时，该参数返回值为空

SourceInstanceState.description_en:
The status of the host. Valid values:

Normal: normal

Release: released
SourceInstanceState.description_zh:
主机状态。取值：
Normal   ：正常
Release： 已释放

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of hosts returned
